definitions.explanation: Describes something that feels fresh, energetic, and pleasantly stimulating. Often used for brisk weather, a crisp atmosphere, or someone's lively and vigorous manner.

examples.japanese: {颯快|さっかい}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{颯快|さっかい}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{元気|げんき}づけた→元気づける：21545_genkizukeru⟧。
examples.english: His brisk manner cheered up those around him.
Taking a walk in the crisp autumn morning air feels better than anything.

notes:
Composed of {颯|さつ} (suddenly, briskly — evoking the sound and feel of wind) and {快|かい} (pleasant, refreshing). A literary and somewhat formal word that conveys both physical freshness and an energetic, admirable quality. The character {颯|さつ} appears in the more common ⟦{颯爽|さっそう}→颯爽：09448_sassou⟧ (dashing, gallant).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {颯快|さっかい}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: a brisk wind
- {颯快|さっかい}な⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: crisp air
- {颯快|さっかい}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧: a brisk, refreshing personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{爽快|そうかい}→爽快：07913_soukai⟧: refreshing, exhilarating — more common; emphasizes feeling refreshed
- ⟦{颯爽|さっそう}→颯爽：09448_sassou⟧: dashing, gallant — describes an impressive, vigorous appearance
- ⟦{清々|すがすが}しい→清々しい：07900_sugasugashii⟧: refreshing, crisp — an i-adjective for clean, fresh feelings
